references.text: God's covenant with Abraham, where He promises to bless him and make his name great, and that all the families of the earth shall be blessed in him.
God establishes His eternal covenant with Abraham and his descendants, promising them the land of Canaan as an everlasting possession.
God confirms the covenant with Isaac and promises to be with him and bless him, reaffirming the oath He swore to Abraham.
God reveals Himself to Jacob and renews the covenant promises given to Abraham and Isaac, including the promise of the land.
God blesses Jacob and repeats the promise of the land that He gave to Abraham and Isaac.
God heard Israel's groaning and remembered His covenant with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.
God remembers His covenant with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, and the promise to give them the land of Canaan.
The Lord is a merciful God who will not forget the covenant He swore to the fathers.
Moses asks God to remember His servants Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.
God remembers His covenant forever, the word He gave to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, about giving them the land of Canaan.
God remembered His covenant with the people and showed compassion according to His great grace.
The prophet asks God not to reject His people for His name's sake, but to remember His covenant.
God will remember the covenant He made with Israel in their youth and establish an eternal covenant.
Zechariah's song of praise, where he blesses God for remembering His holy covenant and the oath He swore to Abraham.
